params.name: id
params.description: ORCID or OMID of the author. Examples: orcid:0000-0002-8420-0696 or omid:ra/06190090508

params.name: require
params.description: Removes rows with empty values in the specified field

params.name: filter
params.description: Applies conditional filtering. Supports regex or operators (=, <, >). Format: field:operator:value. Example: date:>2015

params.name: sort
params.description: Orders results by field in ascending or descending order. Format: asc(field) or desc(field).

params.name: json
params.description: Transforms JSON data structure. Supports array splitting or dict conversion.

items.docs:
Retrieves the bibliographic metadata for each bibliographic entity authored by the person identified by the given ORCID or OpenCitations Meta Identifier (OMID).
Fields returned: id, title, author, pub_date, issue, volume, venue, page, type, publisher, editor.
